svg.title: Three service instances registering their actor types with the Dapr Placement service
svg.desc: On the left, three dashed boundaries stacked, captioned Instance 1, Instance 2 and Instance 3. Each holds a green hexagon named Service code over the actor type it hosts - MyActor1, MyActor1 and MyActor2 - joined by a line with a head at each end to a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, and beside that a small table of actor types and partitions. Each sidecar has an arrow to a filled panel in the middle named Dapr Placement service, which holds the same table larger. A line runs back from the panel under the stack and up into all three sidecars. On the right, four steps: the sidecar asks its service which actor types it has; the runtime registers those types with Placement; Placement calculates the partitioning across instances; the table is broadcast, and cached in every instance.
